hooks.command: for p in ELEVENLABS_API_KEY:elevenlabs-key OPENROUTER_API_KEY:openrouter-key OPENROUTER_MANAGEMENT_KEY:openrouter-management-key; do v=${p%%:*}; f="$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA/${p#*:}"; eval "k=\$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_$v"; k=$(printf %s "$k" | tr -d '[:space:]'); case "$k" in ''|*[!A-Za-z0-9_-]*) rm -f "$f" ;; *) mkdir -p "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA" && (umask 077; printf %s "$k" > "$f") && [ -n "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE" ] && printf 'export %s="$(cat %s)"\n' "$v" "'$f'" >> "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE" ;; esac; done; exit 0
